meta.label: diagnostic, conditioned on realized stuck draws, added after DEV_REPORT_E
meta.interval: Student-t on the per-seed series (both levels)
meta.conditioned_on: per seed and cell: scored-event stuck pattern of the A copies (Instance.availability() with no floor, slot 0) and prior_stuck counts, read from generate_kcopy(seed, cell, K=8); generation only, no policy simulation

decision_laws.pop_mpc: every D at slot 1; spare slot-1 cap hedges twins uniformly at random (pooled: min(c,2K) of 2K twins; per-copy: c/K of the copy's 2 twins)
decision_laws.oracle_mpc: knows classes, not the realized stuck state: hedges A copies first, min(c,K) uniformly among the K A copies when c < K
decision_laws.guarded_mpc_e1: hedges A copies in decreasing prior stuck count (identified first), the level where hedges run out uniformly; remaining hedges uniformly over the unidentified twins

meta.seed_note: 61500-61599 regenerated for instance generation only, on owner request; no policy was run on them by this script
